note: A rule unit is hard-excluded only for a reason scripts/quality/cnl.mjs verifies from the digested text. embedded-table means the unit's normative content embeds a Markdown table; without a table-to-sentences preprocessor there is nothing for a controlled sentence to carry. Earlier exclusion classes - naming no model type, document self-reference, section cross-references - were heuristics over wording and exclude nothing. measured is refreshed by --update and is compared field by field against a live recomputation on every run; both floors are ratchets that --update may raise and never lowers.
